basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old college student currently studying computer science in Berlin, Germany. I'm relatively new to Reddit and the Cardfight Vanguard Zero community but have been a fan of deck-building games since my teenage years. In my free time, I enjoy playing video games, particularly strategy games like Battletech, and I recently got interested in the mechanics of blockchain tokens, like MoonTokenBSC. I usually browse Reddit for gaming tips and discussions during the late evening hours, around 9 PM to midnight, Berlin time. I'm currently single and enjoy engaging in online communities to share experiences and learn from others.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge mainly stems from my ongoing studies in computer science and my long-standing interest in strategy games. I picked up Cardfight Vanguard Zero after a friend recommended it, and I'm still getting a hang of the game mechanics and community strategies. I've been dabbling in blockchain tech and cryptocurrencies through self-learning, which is why I occasionally visit subreddits like MoonTokenBSC.
